text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Hey, Trainer! Come over here,
please!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at these photos Falco and I
took. She
took me to an, uh...
Umasta...gram...mable cafe
during my
break.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I tried taking some selfie pictures of
myself, but I
had no idea it'd be so hard!
Only half of my face
is showing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'd like to go again and try my
hand at
another one over a nice parfait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like Wonder Acute made the
most of her
time off!
